_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Conversation size, in tokens, at which older history is summarized to save context.
examples: let chats get longer before summarizing

settings.description: How many tokens of the most recent conversation are kept word for word when history is summarized.
examples: keep more recent messages when summarizing

settings.description: Conversation size, in tokens, at which the agent stops to finish a background summary before continuing.
examples: let the agent keep working longer while summarizing
settings.notes: Below trigger_tokens or absent means the trigger; the model's context limit caps it.

settings.description: Whether summaries are written by the agent's own model (reusing its cached request) or by the System model.
examples: use the system model for compaction
settings.notes: Applies to the trigger, a requested fold, a retry and the hard limit alike. Claude and OpenCode bridges fork the chat's session when their client reports fork support; after fork_attempts failed forks in a row the selected model gets a new session instead. Muse and bridges without fork support use System.

settings.description: Total size, in tokens, of summary blocks above which the oldest blocks are merged into one.
examples: allow more summary blocks before merging

settings.description: Smallest amount of earlier conversation, in tokens, that /compact or the agent's task fold will summarize.
examples: only compact when there is a lot to fold

settings.description: How many failed bridge forks in a row a session allows before its next summary starts a new session with the selected model instead of forking.
examples: stop retrying failed compaction forks sooner
try forking the session more times before giving up
